name: anime-flat-v1

strip_from_subject: plain gray background, clean silhouette, flat even lighting.
notes: Anime characters (private sources). Animagine XL 3.1 knows booru character tags; the tags go in the source's per-id override `prompt_extra` in the private repo, never here. 1024x1024 matches the OpenPose template (a different aspect would stretch the pose). Flat cel colours and a plain white background so Pixal3D does not bake shading. Same A-pose OpenPose ControlNet as the house style (biped), which keeps limbs readable for rigging. Untested until the first MHA batch.
